about:
# DynamicEventButton
Retextures the Event button based on the current Event level.

Based on a hit tweet by Colon: https://nitter.net/TheRealGDColon/status/1948472513488715849

For best results, use High graphics settings. <c-FF0000>Any visual errors from using Low or Medium graphics settings will be ignored.</c>

This [Geode mod](https://geode-sdk.org) is licensed under LGPLv2. To report bugs or get help with using my mods, press the Discord button in the lower left corner.
changelog:
# DynamicEventButton Changelog
## v1.0.7
- Port to Geode v5.9.0 to use  `geode::Label`  .
## v1.0.6
- Allow changing the endpoint for fetching event logos.
- Fix a bug where levels shorter than a certain amount created tall labels.
## v1.0.5
- Update the mod to use a different endpoint for fetching event logos.
## v1.0.4
- Port to GD 2.2081.
## v1.0.3
- Experimental iOS JIT-less support.
- Added `Level Name Kerning` for those who want to match their texture pack's font's kerning for other CreatorLayer buttons.
## v1.0.2
- Adjusted a few smaller things to better adapt to cases when level creators leave the Caps Lock key on when naming their Event levels. 
## v1.0.1
- Added an option to hide the label (for texture packs such as GD Clean by Asky).
## v1.0.0
- Initial release (on GitHub).
